description:
FILED s453 (Fable box-elision review, faster-codegen-suggestions.md par.13 gap 1).  BLOCK eval boxes the whole region: VarAnnotator _tw_region_facts sets has_eval on ANY eval Word token, and eval-in-region then boxes EVERY name declared in the region -- the code comment defers narrowing block eval and it was never scheduled.  Probe: adding one line `my $r = eval { 1 };` to a sub whose accumulator loop otherwise emits fully raw (p-foreach-range-raw + p-incf-raw) boxes the accumulator.  FIX: veto STRING eval only -- the mechanism that needs cells is the eval capture alist (#296-B1), a string-eval-only feature; eval BLOCKS are plain control flow with no name capture (die/unwind is fine across raw let slots).  PPI shape distinguishes them (Word eval followed by a Block sibling = block eval; keep the veto when the operand is an expression, incl. eval EXPR of a variable).  A nested string eval inside an eval block is still caught (the walk descends).  Frequency: eval {} is THE exception idiom -- this robs whole subs of every raw slot in real code.  Bar: the rename/scoping row of the WHAT-TO-RUN table does NOT apply (no rename change), but this widens where raw emission fires, so corpus-diff + full sweep + the bench.  Priority 1 of the four par.13 gaps.

DONE s456af.  Kind-A gate `raw-block-eval` in Pl/Passes.pm; the fix is in _tw_region_facts: has_eval now fires only for an `eval` Word whose next SIGNIFICANT sibling is not a PPI::Structure::Block.  PPI is unambiguous here -- probed nine spellings, `eval {` always lexes the brace run as a Block, never a hash Constructor.  A STRING eval nested inside an eval block still vetoes (find() descends; the inner Word has no Block sibling) -- guarded.  The eval block BODY was already walked with the seam flag by _tw_expr_parse, so its writes still count as write-embedded; that is also why #758 buys less than it looks in practice -- a write INSIDE the block still boxes the name (probes e02/e06/e10/e12/e14/e15).  15 probes vs perl identical.  No bench row exercises the shape.  Guard: Pl/t/raw-verdict-coverage-01.t rows 1-6.
